newsitem.title: UK: Fedex says UPS strike has no impact on Euro trade.
newsitem.headline: Fedex says UPS strike has no impact on Euro trade.

text.p: Federal Express Corp said it had only seen a very slight increase in call and pickup volumes since the start of the strike by Teamster employees of United Parcel Service yesterday.

"It's a normal business day. There has been no impact on business," a Fedex spokeswoman for the company's European, Middle East and African operations told Reuters in a telephone call from the company's Brussels regional base.

"Obviously, the longer it goes on the more likely it is that there will be an impact. We already have normal reporting systems in place to monitor any upturn in activity and we'll be keeping a closer eye on these, " she added.

"If there was a big increase in business, we will continue to treat our existing customers as top prority," the spokeswoman added. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
